title: Story House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away in the serene Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community, The Story House offers a charming coastal escape just a short two-minute stroll from private beach access. This inviting three-bedroom, three-bathroom cottage is thoughtfully designed for up to nine guests, featuring an open-concept living and dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private screened porch surrounded by native Florida greenery. Two porch swings and an al fresco dining table make the outdoor space a perfect setting for morning coffee or breezy afternoon chats. Indoors, natural textures and whimsical touches, like Elizabeth Wade’s storybook-inspired watercolors, blend comfort with character. Families will appreciate the triple bunk room designed with kids in mind, a peaceful master suite with a canopy bed, and a second queen suite for added privacy. With complimentary bikes provided, guests can easily explore 30A’s highlights—including Alys, Rosemary, and Seacrest Beaches—or hop on the nearby Timpoochee Trail for a scenic ride. The community pool adds a refreshing touch, and the home’s beachy ambiance invites rest and reconnection. Whether creating sandcastles or savoring dinners around the table, The Story House promises a stay filled with warmth, memory-making, and just the right dash of coastal magic.
